_comment: Aquarius's checklists as Apollo 13's lifeboat, docked to Odyssey from the failure to LM JETT: its activation and docked alignment on Odyssey's gimbal angles, the descent engine's burns on the PGNS (the free return, PC+2), MCC-5 by hand on the AGS with the PGNS off, the PGNS again for MCC-7 on the jets, and SM SEP on the AGS [adapted for this simulator from the Apollo Flight Journal's account; the flight's procedures were written on the ground as it flew]. Keys as in checklists.json: V/N/Enter = VERB/NOUN/ENTR, Space = PRO; the switches are on Aquarius's HUD and in its cabin. control: the cabin control a step is done on (an id in data/cockpit/lm_controls.csv). Every step checks itself off.

steps.text: Odyssey's power-down; Houston: get over into the LM
LGC MODE - FREE: Odyssey's DAP holds the stack until its power-down
LM PWR - ON: the LM's batteries on its buses
PGNS - ON: the LGC and its IMU
V41N20E: load Odyssey's gimbal angles through the docking (Houston's), coarse align
Houston: power the CSM down
LGC MODE - HOLD: the LGC flies the stack as Odyssey goes dark
Houston: the LGC's REFSMMAT, Odyssey's carried across (UPLINK ACTY)
Houston's PAD uplinked (UPLINK ACTY): V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO
V37E 40E - P40 DPS Thrusting, TIG-15 min
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver the stack to the burn attitude
ENG ARM - DES
At TIG-5 s V99N40 flashing: PRO for engine on (the PAD's throttle: PC+2 5 s at the minimum, 21 s at 40 %, then full)
Monitor V16N40 (TFI, VG, DV) - DPS cutoff
ENG ARM - OFF
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - HOLD: the stack held
Houston: the PGNS off to save the LM's power
PGNS - OFF: the LGC dark, its platform lost
Houston: the MCC-5 PAD by voice, 7.8 ft/s along +X at 105:18:28
AGS - ON
GUID CONT - AGS; LGC MODE - HOLD: the AGS holds the stack
Point +X along the burn on the ACA (the Earth's terminator in the COAS); at TIG-20 s AGS ALIGN (the DEDA's 400+5, then 400+0); +X on the TTCA, 10 s of ullage
Throttle at the minimum; ENG ARM - DES
ENGINE START at the TIG
ENGINE STOP at the PAD's DV less 0.4 ft/s on DEDA 470 (its tail-off)
ENG ARM - OFF
Trim to the PAD's DV on the TTCA's +X (DEDA 470), then AGS - OFF

checklists.title: The PGNS again: MCC-7 (P41) and SM SEP

steps.text: PGNS - ON, at 133:30
GUID CONT - PGNS
LGC MODE - FREE
Houston: the coarse align angles; V41N20E, load them: coarse align
Houston: the LGC's REFSMMAT (UPLINK ACTY)
LGC MODE - HOLD
Houston's MCC-7 PAD uplinked: V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO
V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting
V50N18 flashing: PRO to the burn attitude
At TIG-5 s V99 flashing: PRO; the +X jets fire
Monitor V16N85 (VG) to zero
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
AGS - ON; AGS ALIGN
GUID CONT - AGS; LGC MODE - HOLD
+X 0.5 ft/s on the TTCA (DEDA 470); Odyssey: CM/SM SEP; then -X 0.5 ft/s
Houston: GO for LM JETT: close up Aquarius, into Odyssey
AGS - OFF
Odyssey: LM JETT. Farewell, Aquarius
